{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script (translated from LSF)

# LSF requested:
#   -P CSC275MCCLURE
#   -J COLOR
#   -o color-3600g.o%J
#   -W 10
#   -nnodes 600
#   (env "all,JOB_FEATURE=NVME" is commented out)

flux alloc \
  -N 600 \
  --time=10m \
  bash -lc '

# NOTE: LSF -P CSC275MCCLURE (project/account) has no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none for runtime, but accounting/charging/allocation association may be incorrect.

# NOTE: LSF job name (-J COLOR) has no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none (metadata only), but job identification in monitoring/accounting may be less clear.

# Approximate LSF %J output naming using Flux job id.
exec >"color-3600g.o${FLUX_JOB_ID}" 2>&1

date

module load gcc cuda

export LBPM_WIA_DIR=$HOME/summit/build/LBPM-WIA/tests

cd /gpfs/alpinetds/csc275/scratch/mcclurej/SCALING/WEAK/3600p

# NOTE: This job uses jsrun (IBM Spectrum LSF/Summit launcher). Flux does not provide a portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: if jsrun is not available/appropriate under Flux, the parallel job may fail to launch
# or may not use the allocated nodes efficiently.
jsrun -n3600 -r6 -g1 -c1 -brs --smpiargs="-gpu" $LBPM_WIA_DIR/TestCommD3Q19

exit
'
"
}
